title: Casablanca
plot: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape the Nazis in French Morocco.
actors: Humphrey Bogart, Ingrid Bergman, Paul Henreid
tagline: They had a date with fate in Casablanca!

title: Citizen Kane
plot: Following the death of a publishing tycoon, news reporters scramble to discover the meaning of his final utterance.
actors: Orson Welles, Joseph Cotten, Dorothy Comingore

title: It's a Wonderful Life
plot: An angel is sent from Heaven to help a desperately frustrated businessman by showing him what life would have been like if he had never existed.
actors: James Stewart, Donna Reed, Lionel Barrymore
tagline: The man who never was... is the man we'll never forget.

title: Metropolis
plot: In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working-class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior.
actors: Brigitte Helm, Alfred Abel, Gustav Froehlich
tagline: The mediator between the head and the hands must be the heart.

title: Seven Samurai
plot: A veteran samurai gathers six other samurai to help him defend a village from bandits.
actors: Toshiro Mifune, Takashi Shimura, Keiko Tsushima
tagline: The Mighty Seven Who Became the Nation's Pride!

title: 12 Angry Men
plot: A jury holdout attempts to prevent a miscarriage of justice by forcing his colleagues to reconsider the evidence.
actors: Henry Fonda, Lee J. Cobb, Martin Balsam
tagline: Life is in their hands. Death is on their minds.
